================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO AFTER EFFECTS TIFF - WANTA HAARAA
Gosa 9.2.9  -  Onkololeessa 2026
================================================================================

THEME-WWAN ANIME haaraan 33 kan Demon Slayer irratti dabalamaniiru, effectoonni maawusii theme-wwanii
amma dhugumaan After Effects keessatti mul'atu, Theme Selector immoo dropdown qulqulluu tokko ta'eera.

JALQABUU DURA
- Gosa kee ammaa irratti installer ZXP kee idilee fayyadamuun install godhi, ergasii
  After Effects altokko deebisii jalqabsiisi.
- Qindaa'inni kee, theme, presets fi expressions kuufaman hundi ni eegamu.

HAARAA: THEME-WWAN ANIME 33
- Qindaa'ina Flex > THEME SELECTOR > MATA-DUREE PANEL keessa amma anime tokkoof garee tokko jira:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) fi Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Taatoleen hundi bifa mataa isaanii qabu: wanta maawusii kee duukaa bu'u, haleellaa yeroo
  buttoona tokko cuqaaftu, wanta yeroo buttoona bitaa qabattee turtu ta'u, akkasumas
  dhoo'insa erga gara sekondii 2.5 qabattee booda dhufu.
- Akkuma theme-wwan Demon Slayer salphaadha: effectoonni yeroo ati sochoosu yookaan cuqaaftu
  qofa hojjetu. Halluu qofa eeguuf EFFECTS NAANNOO cufi.

JIJJIIRAME: THEME SELECTOR
- Kaardiiwwan Demon Slayer MATA-DUREE PANEL jala turan hin jiran, kanaafuu Qindaa'ina Flex
  gabaabbateera. Theme hunda dropdown MATA-DUREE PANEL irraa filadhu; inni theme ati
  amma fayyadamaa jirtu irratti banama.
- Kurama fi Baryon amma garee Naruto keessa jiru.

SIRREEFFAME
- Effectoonni maawusii theme-wwanii (bishaan, abidda, bakakkaa fi kan biroo) yeroo baay'ee
  After Effects keessatti hin mul'atan turan, yeroo Optimised Mode cufamee illee. Yeroon paanelichi
  mataan isaa hojiin qabame, fi jalqabni hojiin qabame, akka theme sun suuta deemuutti
  fudhatamaa turan, kanaafuu effectoonni ofumaan dhaamsamaa turan. Amma, yeroo kaardiin
  giraafiksii kee isaan kaasu (kompiitara baay'ee irratti), yeroon sun effectoota yeroo gabaabaaf qofa salphisa.

HIN JIJJIIRAMNE
- Laayisansii, hojii irra oolchuu fi liinkiin hundi akkuma duraan hojjetu.
- Theme-wwan Demon Slayer 11n akkuma 9.2.8 keessa turanitti mul'atu.
- Taabonni fi meeshaaleen kaan hundi akkuma 9.2.8 keessa ture hojjetu.
================================================================================

- Yeroo FOOTER SIRREESSI Qindaa'ina Flex keessatti cufamu, ergaawwan mirkaneessaa gonkumaa
  mul'achuu hin danda'an turan. Amma yeroo hunda ni mul'atu.
- Dropdown MATA-DUREE PANEL erga theme jijjiiramee booda illee maqaa theme duraanii agarsiisuu
